escena: SCENE (data review in a converted industrial hall, Santiago, early morning): enormous shafts of low sun come through the high clerestory windows and stand in the hazy air as solid visible columns of light, striping the concrete floor; she stands very small at the bottom of the frame in front of a wall-sized screen, one arm raised mid-gesture as she reads across it, dwarfed by the space. She wears a fine light heather-grey knit sweater; no jacket, no navy or blue clothing. She looks up at the screen, never at the camera. The screen glows cool azure blue with a simple abstract plot, softly out of focus and unbranded. 35mm lens at f/4, focus on her. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of a matte dark steel equipment trunk standing in DEEP SHADOW between the camera and the hall, well outside the path of the light shafts
lecho.tono: DARK near black in shadow, matte, with subtle texture but no highlights at all
